title: The King Says, "You May Go Home!"
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who goes looking, and tonight God’s people set out on the long road home: Scout explores a brand-new house, trusts God to lead the way, and finds good things there.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because going home took trust that Heavenly Father would lead the way. In Scout’s world today: Scout’s family just moved to a brand-new house, and the new room felt strange and a little scary. But Scout took a big breath, remembered Heavenly Father leads His children, and went exploring — finding a friendly neighbor’s dog and the coziest reading corner. “Heavenly Father helped me find good things here!” Just like the people trusted Him on the road home, Scout trusted Him in a brand-new place.
